lines.text: بعقده ذنب عرض شمالي هابط ناقص باشد واگر در طرف شمالي سمت الرّاس گذرد و صاعد
lines.en: at the node of the Tail, the northern latitude is descending and decreasing. And if it passes on the northern side of the zenith and is ascending

lines.text: ناقص واز عقده ذنب نارسيده ببعد عرض جنوبي هابط زايد باشد اگر قمر از سمت الرّاس
lines.en: and decreasing, and from the node of the Tail, not having reached the distance of the southern latitude, it is descending and increasing. If the Moon passes from the zenith

lines.text: در طرف جنوب گذرد چنانکه در اکثر معموره الا جنوبي صاعد زايد بود چنانکه در بعضي
lines.en: on the southern side, as in most of the inhabited world, except the southern, it is ascending and increasing, as in some

lines.text: از غايت بغايت عرض باز بعقده الرّاس عرض جنوبي صاعد ناقص بود واگر در طرف
lines.en: from the extreme to the extreme of latitude, again at the node of the Head, the southern latitude is ascending and decreasing. And if on the side

lines.text: شمال سمت الرّاس گذرد وجنوبي هابط ناقص واهل احکام کوکب صاعد را شديد الوتر
lines.en: north of the zenith it passes, and the southern is descending and decreasing. And the astrologers call the ascending planet 'strong in chord'

lines.text: گويند واگر هابط باشد مسترخي الوتر گويند وصورت مدار قمر با منطقة البروج وتزايد و
lines.en: and if it is descending, they call it 'relaxed in chord'. And the form of the orbit of the Moon with the zodiac and the increase and

lines.text: تناقص عرض او برين نهج است وهر يک از راس وذنب را سيريت معکوس يعني
lines.en: decrease of its latitude is in this manner. And each of the Head and Tail has a retrograde motion, that is,

lines.text: بر خلاف توالي متحرک دابجاجه مرکب
lines.en: moving contrary to the succession [of the signs], composed

lines.text: از دو نقطه شخصي اند از فلک جوزهر
lines.en: of two individual points from the sphere of the Jawzahar

lines.text: که بخلاف توالي متحرک ومقدار اين
lines.en: which moves contrary to the succession. And the amount of this

lines.text: حرکت در ارصاد مشهوره در شبانروزي
lines.en: motion in the famous observations in a day and night

lines.text: سه دقيقه وده ثانيه باشد از دور
lines.en: is three minutes and ten seconds of a revolution.

lines.text: تقويم نام شمسي موضع راس خمر را
lines.en: The ephemeris of the solar year [gives] the position of the Head of the Moon

lines.text: در جدولها بعد از جدول تقويم
lines.en: in the tables after the table of the ephemeris

lines.text: عطارد در نصف النّهار هر روزي بازاي اندوز بياورند به رقم اوّل برج دوّم درجه سيّم
lines.en: of Mercury at noon of every day, they bring it opposite the accumulation, with the first digit being the sign, the second the degree, the third

lines.text: دقيقه بر قياس تقويم کواکب وموضع ذنب برج هفتم موضع راس باشد بماند درجه ودقيقه
lines.en: the minute, on the analogy of the ephemeris of the planets. And the position of the Tail is the seventh sign from the position of the Head, the degree and minute remaining

lines.text: چه موضع دو نقطه متقابل در فلک بر اين وجه است پس ايراد موضع يکنقطه کافي باشد
lines.en: since the position of two opposite points in the sphere is in this manner, so the presentation of the position of one point is sufficient.

lines.text: وعلامت راس در تقويم ثلثه باشد واشبا را بتصورت بحته است که اگر سيني نويسند
lines.en: And the sign of the Head in the ephemeris is three [dots?], and its resemblance is to a pure form, that if they write a 'sin'

lines.text: برقم شمس شبيه شود علامت ذنب وگاه باشد که علامت راس نويسند به بعضي قواين
lines.en: resembles the digit of the Sun, it is the sign of the Tail. And sometimes it happens that they write the sign of the Head according to some rules.

summary.headline: Lunar Nodes and Ephemeris Notation
summary.text: Discussion of the Moon’s ascending and descending latitude at the Head and Tail nodes, including the astrologers’ terms “strong in chord” and “relaxed in chord.” It explains the nodes’ retrograde motion, gives its observed daily rate, and describes recording the lunar Head and Tail in solar-year ephemerides using zodiac sign, degree, and minute.
